**UI Audit: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (Scanning State)**

### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768px (Maximized).
*   **Header Bar:** [0, 0, 1024, 50]. Contains App Title (Left), Action Buttons (Right: Buy Now, Target, Info, Menu, Minimize, Maximize, Close).
*   **Navigation Bar:** [0, 51, 1024, 115]. Contains Breadcrumbs/Location (Left), View Toggles & Filter (Center-Right), Search Bar (Far Right).
*   **Main Content Area:** [0, 116, 1024, 815]. Split into three vertical panes:
    *   **Tree Pane (Left):** [0, 116, 275, 815]. Contains Path/Type tabs and directory tree.
    *   **List Pane (Center):** [276, 116, 795, 815]. File list with headers.
    *   **Preview Pane (Right):** [796, 116, 1024, 815]. File preview/details.
*   **Status Strip (Bottom):** [0, 816, 1024, 940].
    *   **Progress Line:** [0, 816, 1024, 845]. Blue background strip showing current file path.
    *   **Control Bar:** [0, 846, 1024, 940]. Contains Gauge, Stats, Timer, and Actions.
*   **Windows Taskbar:** [0, 941, 1024, 1000].

### 2. TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Header:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free"
*   **Button:** "Buy Now"
*   **Nav Location:** "Windows (C:)"
*   **Nav Search Placeholder:** "Search files or folders"
*   **Nav Button:** "Filter"
*   **Tree Tabs:** "Path", "Type"
*   **Tree Items:**
    *   "Windows (C:)" | "1.1M"
    *   "File Path Lost" | "4.3K"
    *   "Reconstructed" | "2"
*   **List Headers:** "Name", "Date Modified", "Type"
*   **List Rows (Sample):**
    *   "actionarchivecache" | "10/7/2026 11:30 PM" | "File folder"
    *   "actions-runner" | "10/17/2026 6:11 PM" | "File folder"
    *   ... (other folders: azureCli, cobertura-2.1.1, ghcup, hostedtoolcache, image, inetpub, Julia, mingw32)
*   **Preview Pane:**
    *   "actionarchivecache"
    *   Button: "Open"
    *   Label: "Size" | Value: "7.29 MB"
    *   Label: "Date Modified" | Value: "10/7/2026 11:30 PM"
    *   Label: "Path" | Value: "C:\"
*   **Status Strip:**
    *   "Searching: ...\0004000000A99A76012F9C6\Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.UserSecrets.dll"
    *   "Advanced Scanning , Files Found: **1139159** (146.29 GB)"
    *   "Remaining time: 13m38s"
    *   "Reading sector: 32317440/313413598"
    *   Button: "Recover All ..."
*   **Taskbar:** "Search", "6:15 PM", "10/17/2026"

### 3. COLOR
*   **Background (App):** `#F5F8FA` (Light Blue-Grey)
*   **Surface (Panes):** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Header/Status Strip BG:** `#FFFFFF`
*   **Progress Strip BG:** `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue)
*   **Primary Accent (Buttons/Gauge):** `#3385FF` (Bright Blue)
*   **Primary Accent Hover/Gradient End:** `#1A75FF` (Darker Blue)
*   **Text Primary:** `#333333` (Dark Grey)
*   **Text Secondary:** `#666666` or `#888888` (Grey)
*   **Text on Primary:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Selection Highlight (List Row):** `#DBEAFF` (Very Light Blue)
*   **Border/Lines:** `#E0E0E0` or `#DDDDDD`

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Font Family:** Segoe UI / System UI Sans-Serif.
*   **Header Title:** ~12px, Normal/Regular.
*   **Nav/Breadcrumbs:** ~13px, Normal.
*   **Tree/List Items:** ~13px, Normal.
*   **Section Headers (Size, Date Modified):** ~12px, Normal, Grey.
*   **Status Text ("Advanced Scanning..."):** ~13px, Bold (for numbers/stats), Normal (for labels).
*   **Gauge Percentage:** ~18px, Bold, White.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Window Padding:** ~10-15px outer margin.
*   **Pane Gutter:** ~5px (divider width).
*   **Row Height (List):** ~42px.
*   **Control Height (Buttons):** ~32-36px (Header), ~40px (Recover All).
*   **Icon Size (List/Tree):** 16x16px or 20x20px.
*   **Gauge Diameter:** ~70px (Circular progress).
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Buttons: ~4px - 6px.
    *   Search/Input: ~4px.
    *   Gauge: Circle (50%).
*   **Shadows:** Very subtle drop shadow on the "Recover All" button and potentially the main window (if not maximized, though it appears maximized here).

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Checkbox (List/Tree):** Square, unchecked state visible for all items.
*   **List Item (Row):**
    *   **State:** Selected (First row "actionarchivecache"). Indicated by light blue background `#DBEAFF`.
*   **Tabs (Path/Type):** "Path" is Active (White bg, top border/shadow), "Type" is Inactive (Grey bg).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   **Buy Now:** Orange/Yellow CTA style. Normal state.
    *   **Filter:** Icon + Text. Normal state.
    *   **Open (Preview):** Light Blue filled button. Normal state.
    *   **Recover All:** Solid Blue primary button. Normal state.
    *   **Pause (Icon):** Two vertical bars. Normal state.
    *   **Stop (Icon):** Solid square. Normal state.
*   **Search Input:** Text field with magnifying glass icon on right.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline/Filled hybrid (mostly filled for file types, outline for actions).
*   **Grid:** Standard 16x16 or 24x24 grid alignment.
*   **Weights:** Consistent stroke width (approx 1.5px - 2px for outlines).
*   **Specific Icons:**
    *   Folder (Yellow/Blue variants).
    *   Hard Drive (Tree root).
    *   Magnifying Glass (Search).
    *   Funnel (Filter).
    *   Pause (Two bars).
    *   Stop (Square).
    *   Clock/History (Next to Recover All).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Active Scanning (In Progress)**.
*   **Motion Cues:**
    *   **Circular Progress Gauge:** Shows **21%** completion. Blue arc on a lighter blue track.
    *   **Progress Bar (Implicit):** The status strip at the bottom implies active processing.
    *   **Stats:** Dynamic counters visible ("Files Found: 1139159", "Remaining time: 13m38s").
    *   **Current Activity:** "Searching: [File Path]" indicates real-time file system traversal.
